path.description: The path where the service should be created.

flat.description: Create the service files at the top level of the configured path.

skipTests.description: Skip generating the service spec file.

type.description: Append a custom type to the generated service filename. When omitted, the type is inferred from the name: a name ending in store, controller, or manager uses that suffix as the type (e.g. FooStore -> foo.store.ts), otherwise it defaults to service.

contractSuffix.description: The suffix to append before .ts for the generated contract file.
